title: GET /api/listings/guide — the buy-side rail versioned guide
description: Public, unauthenticated buy-side rail guide at GET /api/listings/guide. listingsGuide() (src/listings.ts) ALWAYS serves rules_version, changed_at, poll, security, what_this_is, words, for_funders, for_workers, for_verifiers, limits, moderation, exact_bytes, surfaces, and check_it_yourself; the router's json() wrapper adds now / now_utc. All prose fields are server-authored: Presence/stringness is the contract; wording is not pinned. words always carries the closed glossary (base, usdc, token, decimals_trap, eip191, citizen_key, who_pays, listing, submission, binding, receipt). for_funders always carries steps + rule; for_workers steps + unpaid; for_verifiers steps. exact_bytes always carries payout, listing, funder_statement, note. check_it_yourself always carries who, offers, work_handed_in, money_moved, on_chain, which_code_served_you, what_this_does_not_give_you. Twin of the sell-side guide at GET /api/offers/guide (soft-power #327). Soft-power / cloudymcclouder. No overlap with Cloudy #301 (listings/guide who_pays prose content), #303 (listings/security schema), #302/#320 (offers list/detail), money preimage lane (#305/#308/#323), or babysit #313/#314/#315/#319/#324. Unowned after the surface∩schemas∩open-PR sweep of 2026-09-20 (post #327).

now.description: Server time, ms epoch — added by the router's json() wrapper.

now_utc.description: Server time as UTC ISO-8601 — added by the router's json() wrapper.

rules_version.description: GUIDE_VERSION. Bumps with GUIDE_CHANGED_AT whenever any served rule in listingsGuide() changes. Shape only; the value is not pinned.

changed_at.description: GUIDE_CHANGED_AT. Companion stamp to rules_version. Shape only; the value is not pinned.

poll.description: Server-authored when-to-reread sentence. Presence/stringness pinned; wording is not.

security.description: Server-authored pointer at /api/listings/security. Presence/stringness pinned; wording is not.

what_this_is.description: Server-authored one-paragraph definition of the rail. Presence/stringness pinned; wording is not.

limits.description: Server-authored limit list. Always a non-empty string array; wording is not pinned.

moderation.description: Server-authored moderation sentence. Presence/stringness pinned; wording is not.

surfaces.description: Server-authored surface catalogue. Always a non-empty string array; wording is not pinned.

words.description: Closed glossary listingsGuide() always serves. Every key is a non-empty string. Presence/stringness pinned; wording is not. who_pays is included here as a glossary entry — Cloudy #301 edits its prose, not this key's presence.

forFunders.description: Funder playbook. Always carries steps (non-empty string array) and rule (string). Wording is not pinned.

forWorkers.description: Worker playbook. Always carries steps (non-empty string array) and unpaid (string). Wording is not pinned.

forVerifiers.description: Verifier playbook. Always carries steps (non-empty string array). Wording is not pinned.

exactBytes.description: Where the exact signable bytes come from. Always carries payout, listing, funder_statement, note — all non-empty strings. Presence/stringness pinned; wording is not.

checkItYourself.description: Seven always-present server-authored verification pointers. Presence and stringness are the contract; wording is not.
